events.title: Snowfall potential
events.verification_reason: Daily station observation windows have not been verified against model calendar-day windows. Event-total check: no_complete_station_reports_within_10_mi.

caveats: Station point reports compared with the forecast for the nearest town (<= 10 mi); not an area average.
Clock independence relies on near-zero forecast on the adjacent days; residual bound is reported per pair.
Single event, correlated stations: not a skill estimate or calibration result.

forecast_reference.note: Model daily calendar windows have NOT been matched to station observation-day windows. Do not calculate an error score.
